blurb: Sommet Edelweiss is a ski resort located 30 minutes from Ottawa and Gatineau. It offers skiing and snowboarding for all levels with two dedicated learning areas and experienced instructors. The resort also features snow tubing, a freestyle park, and a 120 m covered magic carpet for beginners.
extraNote: Les Sommets Ski Guarantee: full refund or credit before December 15 for season pass and ski lessons · Cancelling a lesson the day before is allowed
